facts.text: I want to write a new Calendly plugin in TypeScript.
I want to deploy the plugin on my servers.
I want the plugin to get user details.
I want the plugin to include methods named getUserDetails, getUsersAllMeetings, getUsersAllPartMeetings, and getUsersAllUpcomingMeetings.
I want the plugin to include a method named getUsersAllPastMeetings.
I asked whether the assistant has an idea how Calendly APIs work.
I asked whether the assistant is making things up.
